6: However, [answering] Amen after [the blessing] "Who redeemed Israel" (Ga'al Yisrael) is not considered an interruption, and it is a mitzvah to answer it, etc. It was explained in section 66 that the prevalent custom, based on the Zohar, is not to answer Amen between Geulah (redemption) and Tefillah (prayer). And there it was also explained whether one may interrupt in order to put on a tallit and tefillin.
